newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine power rates mostly higher in June.
newsitem.headline: Philippine power rates mostly higher in June.

text.p: Power rates in almost every grid in the Philippines rose in June except for one, the state-owned National Power Corp said on Thursday.
The power rate in the main island of Luzon went up 1.68 centavos per kilowatthour (kwh) to 2.3087 pesos per kwh.
Napocor officials said the higher fuel cost pushed up the electricity rates especially in the predominantly bunker fuel-fed Luzon grid.
The power rate for the Mindanao grid rose by 1.65 centavos per kwh to 1.4082 pesos.
Buyers of Napocor power are mostly electricity distributors and cooperatives.

The Leyte-Samar grid rate inched up one centavo per kwh to 2.1192 pesos; the Cebu-Negros-Panay grid went up by 2.28 centavos to 2.2226 pesos; while the Bohol grid went down by 8.82 centavos to 2.4461 pesos.
The grids are in the different islands in central Philippines.
